_meta.source: Derived mapping for Kierston trainer exercise strings. Seed names/body/equipment inspired by public ExerciseDB-style catalogue metadata (text only). Not a wholesale ExerciseDB dump. No openGym / Gym visual media. Fine muscle tags are best-effort from exercise names.
